text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A wedding is going to be held at Tracen
Academy
today, and the bride herself is
a graduate. The
wedding planner,
however, is of course...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for coming today, everybody!
Welcome to
the wedding!

text_block_list.name: Graduate Guests
text_block_list.text:
Wow, the smell of the turf really takes
me back!
But I wonder why we're all
lined up here?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That's because... We've got a race
planned for
today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bam!
choice_data_list: 結婚式に、メインレース？
choice_data_list_en: A wedding, and the main race?

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Today's race is the Wedding Stakes! It's
a
1,400-meter turf race! And every
single runner's
flown out of the gate at
once!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The bride's in the lead! This distance is
sure to be
nostalgic as it's the same
length as her debut
race! As she sprints
down it now, she enters a new
stage in
her life!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Graduate
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Ahaha... I remember these sights... so well!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That was a wonderful entrance for all the
key
players! But we're not done yet!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, please take a look at that
huge screen
over there!

Ready, and... Congratulations on your
marriage!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Graduate
text_block_list.text:
That banner! No way, those people...
Can it be?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Graduate's Fans
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for all the memories and joy
you've
given us! Now it's your turn to be
happy!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
All your fans got together to
congratulate you!
Hehe. Look how
happy they are!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
We're gonna start the reception off with
a mini
performance from the bride and
her friends!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Let's turn up the party with some songs!
Come on,
everyone! Sing along, dance,
and enjoy
yourselves!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Graduate
text_block_list.text:
I'm taking the center position today!
Okay,
everyone, are you ready?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the wedding Haru Urara
planned just
keeps bringing joy to its
many attendees...

text_block_list.name: Emcee
text_block_list.text:
Right, next up, the bride's going to read
her vows!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hoo boy! This is the grand finale! I
wonder if she's
nervous.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Graduate
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all very much for coming
today. I'm
overjoyed that I get to start a
new chapter of my
life here, where I
chased after my dreams.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Graduate
text_block_list.text:
There's somebody I'd like to introduce
to you all.
She's the one who organized
this wonderful
wedding.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Graduate
text_block_list.text:
Please give a round of applause to my
muse,
Urara!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Me?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Graduate
text_block_list.text:
The emotions I felt during races, the
precious
time I spent with people I
love... All those
sparkling days of joy
came back to me today.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Graduate
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for putting together
such a
wonderful and exciting wedding
for me, Urara!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Aww! ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
To tell you the truth, at first, I didn't
know how to
organize a wonderful
wedding for you.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So I thought and thought about it, and
my plan
got really wild!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
But then, all the Muses reminded me of

something! I remembered what you said
when you
asked me to help out.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Graduate
text_block_list.text:
And you, my little muse, are always
doing your
very best to make things
exciting, and when I
looked at you, I had
a thought.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Graduate
text_block_list.text:
If you helped me, my wedding would
definitely be
wonderful and one to
remember!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
When you told me that, my first thought
wasn't to
throw you a super grand party.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
All I wanted to do was give you and
everyone else
an exciting time!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to show you how fun and
incredible
every day will still be for you!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So I tried to make sure your new start
was super
full of fun and excitement!
That's my present to
you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm walking around the academy a few
days after
the wedding when I spot Haru
Urara reading a
letter with a grin on her
face.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"So basically, every day is super
exciting! I'm sure
lots more fun days are
waiting for you in the
future too, Urara!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"In the future"! I wonder what those days
will be
like? Hmm, I don't really know...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
But I sure hope that even when I'm an
old lady,
years and yeeears in the
future, I'll still be having
megatons of
fun!
